title: Enforce the request limits when admitting each request.
comment:
**Enforce the request limits when admitting each request.**

If two image requests enter `window.fetch` together, both can pass these checks before either adds a row. Line 21 spaces out their starts, but does not repeat the checks. The continuation can therefore exceed its 17-request limit or spend cap. Reserve a request slot and its budget inside one serialized admission step before starting the request.
